about_remdy_paragraph_1: Remdy is an app created to connect real people around the world in a simple, natural, and safe way.
about_remdy_paragraph_2: We live in a time with many social networks, but few truly help people build real connections. Remdy was born with a different purpose: to bring people, cultures, and languages closer through real conversations.
about_remdy_paragraph_3: Learning a language, making friends in other countries, or discovering new cultures should not be difficult.
about_remdy_paragraph_4: We believe the best way to learn is by talking, sharing experiences, and living the language in everyday life.
about_remdy_paragraph_5: That is why Remdy was created to allow anyone to:
about_remdy_paragraph_6: No complications. No confusing algorithms. Just people connecting with people.
about_remdy_global_title: A global app from the beginning
about_remdy_paragraph_7: Remdy was designed for the world. From day one, the goal has always been to create an international community.
about_remdy_paragraph_8: Creating a healthy environment is a priority. We work with clear rules, moderation, and controls to protect users.
about_remdy_paragraph_9: Remdy is still growing, and many new features are on the way.
about_remdy_thanks_title: Thank you for being part of it
about_remdy_paragraph_10: Remdy is not just an app. It is a global community built by people, for people.

privacy_location_3: GPS location when authorized by your device

faq_countries_available_q: In which countries is Remdy available?
faq_countries_available_a: Availability can change as we roll out. We currently focus on countries such as Brazil, Canada, and Portugal. New countries may be added over time. Worldwide availability is not guaranteed right away.
faq_change_country_a: Your main country may stay locked after the initial setup. This helps reduce fraud and inconsistencies. Legitimate changes may require support or a future option in the app.
faq_city_location_q: How does Remdy use my city and location?
faq_city_location_a: Your city helps show relevant people, groups, and events. GPS location is used only if you allow it. You can change the permission in your device settings. Remdy may use city and approximate location — not continuous real-time tracking.
faq_who_sees_profile_a: Other users can see the public information on your profile, such as name, photo, city, languages, bio, and public photos. Age may appear when it is shown on your profile. Public fields are not fully private.
faq_delete_account_q: How do I delete my account?
faq_delete_account_a: Go to Menu → Delete my account. You will confirm and may need to sign in again. Deleting your Remdy account does not cancel a store subscription. Some shared content may be anonymized or kept for integrity and safety.
faq_logout_a: Use Log out in the Menu. Logging out only ends your session — it does not delete your account.
faq_languages_available_a: The app is available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese, Spanish, and French. User-created content may not be perfectly translated.
faq_message_anyone_a: Free accounts may have limits by country. Premium can unlock international chats and discovery. Blocks, safety tools, and community rules still apply.
faq_world_option_q: How does the World option work?
faq_world_option_a: World expands discovery to other countries. It can be a Premium feature. Availability depends on your account, country, and app version.
faq_block_person_a: Open the person's profile or chat, open the menu, and choose Block. After that, interaction is limited according to Remdy's rules.
faq_report_person_a: Use Report in a profile, chat, group, or content. Choose a reason and send it. Our team may review and take action. False or abusive reports can also break the rules.
faq_reads_messages_a: Messages are processed technically for delivery, safety, and app features. They may be reviewed when reported or when needed to investigate abuse. We do not manually read every message.
faq_groups_how_a: Groups bring people together by city, region, country, or interest, depending on the group settings. Some groups are open; others need approval or an invite. Owners and admins can moderate members and content.
faq_cant_join_group_q: Why can't I join a group?
faq_cant_join_group_a: Possible reasons: the group needs approval, it is invite-only, there is a location limit, your account was removed or banned, the group ended, or access depends on Premium.
faq_create_group_a: Yes, when creation is available in the app and you follow Remdy's rules. The creator is responsible for moderation. Groups that break the rules may be removed.
faq_events_how_a: Users or organizers can publish events. Events may need approval. You can discover events by city or region. Details come from the organizer — always confirm time, address, price, and conditions before you go.
faq_events_organized_by_remdy_a: Not always. Remdy is usually a platform to share and discover events. The main responsibility belongs to the identified organizer.
faq_create_event_a: You can create events in the app when the feature is available for your account. Posts may need approval, and edits may need approval again.
faq_event_pending_q: Why is my event pending approval?
faq_event_pending_a: Events are reviewed to reduce fraud, inappropriate content, or incorrect information. Review time can vary. The event appears publicly only after approval.
faq_what_is_remi_a: Remi is Remdy's virtual assistant. It uses artificial intelligence to help with chats, questions, and guidance inside the app. Remi is not a real person.
faq_remi_always_correct_a: No. AI can make mistakes or misunderstand something. Remi should not replace medical, legal, financial, or emergency advice.
faq_remi_private_chats_q: Does Remi see my private chats?
faq_remi_private_chats_a: Remi processes only the messages you send directly to it and the data needed for that conversation. Other chats are not treated as chats with Remi unless the app clearly says so.
faq_what_is_premium_a: Premium unlocks benefits such as international / World access and other Premium features shown in the app. Benefits may vary by country, platform, and version.
faq_how_subscribe_q: How do I subscribe to Premium?
faq_how_subscribe_a: Open the Premium screen, choose an available offer, and confirm with the App Store or Google Play. The official price is shown by the store.
faq_how_cancel_q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq_how_cancel_a: Cancel in the App Store or Google Play. Deleting your Remdy account does not cancel the subscription. Access may continue until the paid period ends.
faq_restore_purchase_q: How do I restore a purchase?
faq_restore_purchase_a: Open the Premium screen and tap Restore purchase. Sign in with the same store account used for the purchase and wait for sync. A short delay is normal.
faq_premium_not_active_q: I bought Premium, but it did not activate. What should I do?
faq_premium_not_active_a: 1) Check your internet. 2) Confirm you are using the same Apple/Google account. 3) Use Restore purchase. 4) Close and reopen the app. 5) Wait a few minutes. 6) Email support@remdy.app.
faq_free_to_use_q: Can I use Remdy for free?
faq_free_to_use_a: Yes. Core free features stay available. Some features, such as broader international reach, may require Premium.
faq_invite_premium_a: Some invite milestones can unlock temporary Premium. This benefit has an end date, is not necessarily a paid subscription, and can coexist with a paid plan. Milestones are shown on the Invites screen.
faq_invite_milestones_q: How many invites do I need?
faq_invite_milestones_a: Current milestones: 3 invites = 1 day; 10 = 7 days; 20 = 30 days; 50 = 60 days; 100 = 90 days plus ambassador benefit. Each milestone is granted once.
faq_invite_expired_q: My invite Premium expired. Did I lose my account?
faq_invite_expired_a: No. Your account stays free. Only Premium features stop being available. A valid paid subscription still works separately.
faq_no_notifications_q: Why am I not getting notifications?
faq_no_notifications_a: Common causes: permission off, battery saver, weak internet, expired session, device settings, or an event/group outside your relevant region.
faq_contact_support_a: Email support@remdy.app. That is our official support address.
